content.title: Graphic design foundations
content.intro: Graphic design organises type, image, colour, and space so a message is clear, useful, and memorable.

sections.title: Hierarchy guides attention
sections.body: Scale, weight, contrast, and position tell people what to notice first, what supports it, and what action or detail comes next.

sections.title: Composition supports the message
sections.body: Alignment, spacing, and grouping create relationships between elements. Every visual choice should help the intended audience understand the message.

next.title: Check graphic design foundations
next.body: Choose the response that best applies the foundation you just learned.

questions.prompt: A poster has five messages competing at the same size and weight. What should the designer do first?
options: Choose the primary message and create a clear hierarchy
questions.explanation: A clear primary message gives the design an intentional reading order.

completion.title: You understand graphic design foundations!
completion.body: You learned how hierarchy, composition, type, and colour guide attention and communicate meaning.
